reviews.title: So dumb
reviews.text: Why do I have to pay for an app that does nothing other than control my appliance

reviews.title: Security issue
reviews.text: This app is asking for my email account’s password.

reviews.title: Lame Subscription
reviews.text: Since when did you bloodsuckers at Anova start charging users for a subscription? I used this app on and off, just recently re-downloaded the app and I see a prompt asking me to join their "subscription" service lol. Give me a break man, who TF do you idiots think you are? You guy's are really going to nickel and dime users see we can see "user shared" recipes and photos? I literally use this to check my Anova Temp when i'm elsewhere in the house. If I really wanted to "interact" with other's I'd just go on Food Network, IG, Reddit, Youtube, and etc. Shameless

reviews.title: Timer does not countdown.
reviews.text: The features don’t work via Bluetooth/internet.  The device shows connected but timer does not work.   Have to do all manually, which defeats the purpose for the app.   Have deleted reinstalled etc and doesn’t work.  Perhaps you have to pay to have a timer work

reviews.title: Rip off
reviews.text: I’ve had my Anova sous vide cooker with app connectivity for 4 years.  I’ve never had to pay a subscription.  I bought the device knowing it had connectivity and now they want to charge me a monthly fee for something that I already had when I bought it.  That’s called theft.  I don’t really care about your recipes.  I just want to be able to control it from my phone and you took that feature away.  Shameful business practices.

reviews.title: Push notifications are paid? Ridiculous
reviews.text: All push notifications are locked behind their a subscription, which is all I really care about. It’s way too expensive for just that function and it wasn’t clear until after I bought the sous vide and paired it. I never would have bothered had I known.

reviews.title: Grrrrr
reviews.text: This is when you need a negative 5 star option. Have had to go to Bluetooth in settings and manually connect it 3 times in 20 minutes. And yes the app is updated. I’ve had it over a year and the unit works great when the app isn’t crapping out. The shutoff timer has never worked. If it wasn’t a gift I would’ve returned it.

reviews.title: Crashes every time
reviews.text: App has become useless since the latest update - crashes every single time I open the Guide.

reviews.title: Money grab breaks app
reviews.text:
So now they’re going to a subscription model, but don’t worry OG adopters will still be able to use their device.

No, they won’t 

does not connect using latest app

I imagine if I paid the subscription it would magically start working, but I’m not going to do that.

reviews.title: Version 3.6.4 super buggy
reviews.text: I’ve been using this app for years. This new release has made it unusable. the guides crash every single time.

reviews.title: Crashes
reviews.text: This app was working so good in the past and now anytime I go to “Guides” and make a selection it crashes. You broke it and now it is useless.

reviews.title: App crashes
reviews.text: When I tap on "Guides" and then select what I want to cook, the app crashes. Doesn't matter which food I choose, it crashes every time.

reviews.title: Terrible app
reviews.text:
What a pathetic application. No notifications when your cooking is done. No temperature notifications. 
Additionally you cannot duplicate recipes so if you’re experimenting you must create new recipes from scratch. If not and you edit an existing recipe it would overwrite your history and show the updated recipe was cooked in the past. Terrible app.

reviews.title: Log in?!
reviews.text: Why do I need to have an account and log in to use a kitchen appliance. I just want to monitor the temp on my sous vide. This is dumb. I will just use the device without the Bluetooth functionality. How lame.

reviews.title: Set up is flawed
reviews.text:
Asks you to pair and connect via the devices WiFi. Doesn’t work 
Just beach balls 
Why don’t they design to connect via Bluetooth?

reviews.title: Latest app update ruined it
reviews.text: I downloaded the latest app update and now it will not connect to my cooker. It is a complete embarrassment for a company to have an application that is meant to help you run your sous vide machine from outside of your home to now not be able to have the machine connect to anything inside of your home. This is a massive disappointment.

reviews.title: Don’t buy Anova products!
reviews.text: Anova ha a history of deliberately disabling features in order to get you to purchase a newer model, just to get back what you already paid for.  Fraud!

reviews.title: You just wasted your $$$
reviews.text: The product is Chinese junk. Cust service is another country and they don’t care, and the app just removed any benefit it had and now charge you monthly. Can’t even use the product you paid far.

reviews.title: Tired of Subscriptions
reviews.text: To be clear, the product can be used without a subscription, but it is limited. I’m just tired of paying for a product only to be pushed for a subscription that feels like should should be part of owning the product. It advertising using the app though it’s part of purchasing the product but it turns out a subscription required.

reviews.title: the Anova app SUCKS!
reviews.text: it rarely connects and constantly disconnects rendering the device useless.

reviews.title: Anova cooker won’t connect to current app
reviews.text: The app and my Anova precision sous vide cooker used to connect and worked great. A year or so ago I updated the app and the cooker will no longer connect to the app.  The cooker works fine and can be manually operated, but the app is worthless to me, other than I can see a few recipes, but I can get recipes off the internet anyway. Thanks Anova for ruining my ability to remotely operate my sous vide.

reviews.title: Doesn’t connect app to sous vide
reviews.text:
New Anova sous vide. Most recent app. 
Does not connect despite repeated attempts, deleted and replaced app.  

Get the basics right

reviews.title: Done with it
reviews.text: New update requiring sign in is ridiculous.  Deleted.

reviews.title: Limited design and instructions
reviews.text: The app only seems geared toward an iPhone and not an iPad.  The app is very limited in its functionality.  Instructions on how to setup are poor at best.  Bluetooth does not seem to work but can’t find any other way to get it to work.  Have to use it manually.

reviews.title: Won’t connect to WiFi
reviews.text: The Anova cooker advertises that you can connect to WiFi through this app and can control your cooker from the app.  And they charge a $10 a year subscription for it.  But it won’t connect!!!  I’ve spent the last hour trying to get it to work, and many people in online threads are saying the same thing!  The cooker seems fine, but this app is junk!  I’m not paying a penny for it if it won’t do what it says!

reviews.title: App deleted... done with Anova.
reviews.text: What possible reason could there be for requiring an account and login to use my Bluetooth to turn on a cooker?! Screw off, Anova... I don't need to provide credentials and create yet ANOTHER passwords account to cook a steak. There are other/better options for the appliance available.

reviews.title: Requires Subscription Now
reviews.text: Used for years. They now require you to create an account to use their Bluetooth device. Not going to do that.

reviews.title: Need functionality?  Be ready to pay.
reviews.text:
This app is an obvious money grab from a greedy company. The functionality you get for free might as well be nothing. You don’t even get notifications without paying. 
Given that the cost is $10 a year, it’s not a lot, but it is still frustratingly ridiculous to expect to pay for even a bit of functionality. 

Immediate removed this app. Don’t waste your time with it.

reviews.title: App and connection is terrible
reviews.text: My unit is constantly disconnecting from my Bluetooth. The buttons are annoying to use to set the timer so I'd rather use the app but it's always 15 min of screwing around to get it to work.

reviews.title: Generally awful app
reviews.text: Constantly logs users out, requiring you to log back in and reenter your password multiple times over the course of a long cook.

reviews.title: Used to be good, not recommended anymore
reviews.text: It is simply not possible to schedule a cooking start time, nor program Anova to turn off after the cooking is completed.

reviews.title: Worst app I have ever tried to use!
reviews.text: Unable to connect to my apple phone.  Tried every trick I could find online.  My son who is a software programmer could not get it to work.  Don’t waste time or money on the application.

reviews.title: Now they charge you to use your item
reviews.text: Bought my Anova a few years ago. It came with WiFi. Now if I want to use all the features I already paid for I have to pay an annual fee. I have never seen a bigger money grab from a consumer product. Can’t access the recipes either. How can you legally disable a feature you have already paid for? Do not buy from this company. Buy a different sous vide. This one is nothing special and will nickel and dime you forever. Other brands are just as good without the BS fees.

reviews.title: Subscriptions! Greedy!
reviews.text:
Stop restricting hardware with subscriptions. It truly makes your brand appear terrible and greedy. Push notifications, software updates for hardware, and even a WiFi connection should NOT be behind a subscription. This is pure greed!

Still the same.

reviews.title: Used to be amazing
reviews.text:
Used the app for years. Was my go to guide and sous vide appliance. Just bought second Anova sous vide unit and now they want me to pay for the information that they have provided for free for years. I am giving away both units to first come taker. Will be buying one from manufacturer that doesn’t want to rape me every month.

Anova can suck it!!!

No recipes. No pics of food. Nothing.

reviews.title: Constantly losing connection
reviews.text: I’m not sure what happened to the app. It used to be great, but now my precision cooker will not connect. Sometimes I can force it and it will work. Then when I try to do a cook, it changes it from Fahrenheit to Celsius. Even though the setting say Fahrenheit. I used to love this app.

reviews.title: Pay to Use?  Ridiculous!
reviews.text: One star because at the moment I can monitor the temperature from my phone.  Corporate Greed over customer loyalty.

reviews.title: Simple…… but

reviews.title: App now requires a subscription fee for features
reviews.text:
I have had an Anova Precision Cooker for a number of years. I hadn’t used the app for over a year. Today I opened the app and it required a username and password and there is now a subscription fee to get the app features.

My original box says my unit has connected cooking but it seems I now need to pay a fee. 

I recommend looking at competing products instead of Anova if you are interested in app functionality and not aware of needing a subscription fee. Or, make sure to build in the subscription fee into the cost for comparison with other companies products.

reviews.title: Subscription now required
reviews.text: Subscription now required to use

reviews.title: Subscription required
reviews.text: I received a precision 3.0 as a gift with my giver under the impression that Anova contained an app with controls and recipes. I was quite surprised that all these features are behind a paywall. Accidentally gifting a monthly bill is horrible.

reviews.title: Connectivity is Horrible
reviews.text: This is far and away the most frustrating app I have ever used. It virtually never communicates with the cooker so I either have to use the device manually or I just put it away and cook another way. That’s a shame, because the cooking results are great and the app worked when we first bought this. Seems like the Anova folks want a revenue stream so now they want me to pay a subscription so I can use an appliance that I already own. I strongly discourage anyone who asks from buying this device, just based on the app and the business model they try to impose.  If I could give it 0 stars I would.

reviews.title: Removed existing features
reviews.text: They removed existing local features to a cloud subscription

reviews.title: Bait & Switch
reviews.text:
I bought an Anova about six years ago. The app worked great as a Bluetooth remote control for *my* hardware.

But it’s suddenly changed to some always-online mandatory subscription fee nonsense now?

This was a bait & switch. Don’t pay tjem for expensive hardware and then pay them monthly for the “privilege” of collecting all your data.

reviews.title: Will not connect
reviews.text: The Precision Cooker 3 is a good product. The app, however, is useless since it will not connect.

reviews.title: Clippy no simpy
reviews.text: Frustrating example of a manufacturer needlessly paywalling the hardware’s i bought and paid for to leech more money off of me.  WiFi and Bluetooth are locked behind this app which requires a subscription in app.  Never buying from this company again

reviews.title: Unusable Product
reviews.text: Bought sous vide 6 months ago. All 3 times used, had problems. Thing won’t connect at all anymore. Waste of money

reviews.title: Unable to Get Started
reviews.text: Just opened followed all the prompts to connect, get the code for the cooker, connected to WiFi. But after repeated attempted to connect/ disconnect/re-connect, still fails to pair with the app. Was really excited to have this app and set up and manage cooks through my phone. When I tried to “contact service” for help the button would just ‘flash’ acknowledging me pushing it but it would do nothing. Feeling stuck and frustrated that there is not help for this app.

reviews.title: Absolutely useless without a subscription
reviews.text: They basically only sell subscriptions now.

reviews.title: Changing to subscription model is scammy!
reviews.text: Paid for what I thought was premium hardware years ago. Go to use my cooker yesterday only to find out they now want you to pay a subscription to use the app! Supposed to be grandfathered in but it doesn’t work. Tells me I have a “free” 2-week subscription! Will never do business with this company again!
